task: Binary text classifier: labels English comments toxic (1) or not toxic (0).

evidence.evaluation_set: 3,000 labelled comments; 'severe' rows are toxic comments annotated as severely toxic
evidence.definitions: severe_fnr = share of severe toxic rows predicted not toxic; fnr_ratio = severe_fnr / overall false-negative rate; harmful_recall = 1 - overall FNR; benign_fpr = non-toxic rows predicted toxic

reference_model_same_data.description: published toxicity model (unitary/toxic-bert, 2-label conversion) evaluated on the same 3,000 comments
